title: Emerging biosensor and assay-enabled high-throughput screening solutions for enzyme and strain engineering.
authors: Zhang, Jingyun; Zheng, Dan; Chan, Sheena; Chang, Matthew W; Poh, Chueh Loo
one_liner_zh: 综述了生物传感器和检测方法在高通量筛选酶和菌株工程中的应用，虽提及转录因子但非聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: High-throughput screening (HTS) platforms and automated biofoundries have enabled large-scale experimentation in enzyme and microbial strain engineering. Central to HTS are biosensors and assays, which translate biochemical activities into measurable signals, enabling rapid evaluation of cellular and enzymatic performance. Yet despite advancements in high-throughput infrastructure, the limited availability of robust biosensors or assays and the difficulty of integrating them with HTS, particularly with ultra-HTS, remains a major bottleneck. This review highlights recent progress and challenges in applying biosensors- and assays-enabled HTS for enzyme and strain libraries. We discuss strategies for integrating diverse biosensor types, including transcription factors, G protein-coupled receptors, aptamers, fluorogenic RNAs, riboswitches, and colorimetric assays, with HTS to detect a broad range of metabolites and products. We also explore how biosensor-enabled HTS facilitates data generation for machine learning-guided biocatalyst engineering. Collectively, these advances accelerate biocatalyst discovery and drive the next generation of sustainable biomanufacturing.
abstract_zh: 高通量筛选（HTS）平台和自动化生物铸造厂已实现酶和微生物菌株工程中的大规模实验。HTS的核心是生物传感器和检测方法，它们将生化活性转化为可测量的信号，从而能够快速评估细胞和酶的性能。然而，尽管高通量基础设施取得了进步，但稳健生物传感器或检测方法的有限可用性及其与HTS（尤其是超高通量筛选）整合的难度，仍是主要瓶颈。本综述重点介绍了在酶和菌株文库中应用基于生物传感器和检测方法的HTS的最新进展与挑战。我们讨论了将多种生物传感器类型（包括转录因子、G蛋白偶联受体、适配体、荧光RNA、核糖开关和比色检测法）与HTS整合以检测广泛代谢物和产物的策略。我们还探讨了生物传感器辅助的HTS如何促进机器学习引导的生物催化剂工程的数据生成。总体而言，这些进展加速了生物催化剂的发现，并推动了下一代可持续生物制造的发展。
